Current comparisons are only for included snapshot entries, projecting their exact2 CURRENT sources and exact2 retained origins into frozen T82 comparator. Excluded entries still fully validated and pinned, produce no scoped output
Snapshot included entries and typed scoped results form exact pairKey+decisionId/hash bijection; no identity-only dedup; included empty =>one unbound abstention AFTER all retained validation
